name: ReusableSettingsTemplate
label: Reusable Settings Template
helpText: Deploy Intune reusable settings from CIPP templates. An existing setting with the same name is diffed against the template and overwritten when it drifts.
executiveText: Deploys Intune reusable policy settings - shared building blocks referenced by security and configuration policies - so the same certificates, file paths and definitions apply consistently across tenants.
docsDescription: Deploy an Intune reusable policy setting from a CIPP template. The standard grades presence by display name and diffs the full setting body against the template via the Intune comparer; remediation creates the setting or overwrites it in place.
